name: Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
summary: Edelstahl-Service Donautal is a financially solid stainless steel service centre: EUR 165 M turnover, 350 staff, equity 33.9 %, stable credit index 177. Our business is only 0.3 % of its turnover. The framework contract ends 2026-12-31 and renews automatically unless notice is given 60 days before. The supplier now wants to reset the price basis and its AS-14404 surcharge clause, and its 2026-09-19 RFQ quote of 6.31 is +15.8 % on the current 5.45. Yet it states its nickel and alloy costs are hedged at fixed prices until March 2027, and on 2026-09-10 it quoted 5.45 valid accordingly.

situation.decision_maker: Owner/managing level (the 'owner' personally offered an open calculation in doc:20260421-70710-M2) within a group structure; expect sales to escalate anything beyond index mechanics.

negotiation_pattern: Opens with modest asks (mean +0.7 %) and settles well below them (mean -2.4 %, settled minus asked -3.1 pts). It has accepted price cuts twice: -7.1 % against an asked -3.1 % in EV-2024, and -1.5 % against an asked +2.0 % in EV-2025. Last renewal it asked +3.2 % and settled +1.4 % (EV-2026). It prefers mechanical, index-based pricing and offers transparency (open calculation) rather than confrontation. The current 6.31 quote looks like an opening anchor rather than a cost-based price.
wants: an agreed price basis and surcharge clause on AS-14404 for the coming period
continuity and renewal of the framework (auto-extension)
payment on time (we pay late in 79 % of cases)
more volume, e.g. the qualified but unused sheet part:370021
protects: index linkage to AS-14404 (it will not accept a pure fixed price beyond its hedge horizon)
list/quote price for new periods (group policy), less so terms

trades.give: volume_per_year: award a share of part:370021 (sheet, qualified, quota 0 %) to them
trades.get: unit_price for part:370010 held at 5.45 until 2027-03-31, as in its own quote
trades.why: Its material is hedged until March 2027, so holding 5.45 costs it nothing, while the extra volume is real value to it.

trades.give: index_clause: accept their AS-14404 surcharge clause from 2027-04 onwards
trades.get: index base reset only from Q2 2027, no index surcharge before hedge expiry, and a symmetric deadband
trades.why: Index rises before April 2027 do not reach its costs, by its own statement; this gives them the clause they asked for.

trades.give: payment_days: commit to strict on-time payment at 30 days
trades.get: unit_price movement toward 5.45 and an OTD commitment toward the 95 % target
trades.why: Paying on time is cheap for us, and our late payment is an irritant it can cite.

trades.get: price annex at 5.45 through 2027-03, the index formula unchanged (0.45 share), and an OTD commitment
trades.why: Gives it planning security at no real cost to us.

arguments.point: You confirmed in writing that nickel and alloys are covered at fixed prices until March 2027 and quoted 5.45 'valid accordingly'. A 6.31 quote nine days later has no cost basis before April 2027.
The existing clause already passes only 45 % material share through AS-14404. A +15.8 % jump would need an implausible index move, so please show the I(m-2)/I(base) calculation.
Take up the owner's offer to walk through the calculation of hourly rates and material.
OTD has been 88-92 % for four quarters against a contractual 95 % target, and one 8D is still open. Delivery performance must improve before any price uplift.
There is a qualified second source for both parts, so the volume is contestable.

avoid: Rejecting any index clause outright. It asked for one, and the existing contract already has one.
Threatening loss of a big customer: we are only 0.3 % of its turnover, so the threat carries little weight.
Raising payment terms as a demand while we pay late 79 % of the time.
Letting the 2026-11-01 notice date pass without an agreed price annex.
tone: Factual and cooperative, numbers-driven. Quote its own letter and quote back to it, and accept its transparency offer.
red_flags: Contract auto-extends after 2026-12-31. Termination or price-change notice must be given 60 days before year end, i.e. by about 2026-11-01.
The 6.31 quote (+15.8 %) is an anchor that contradicts its stated hedge to March 2027.
OTD consistently below the 95 % target, with one open 8D (last complaint 2026-09-06).
After March 2027 its hedge expires and real alloy cost pass-through will start.
The quote for alternative part:370021 is from 2024 and stale, so it must be re-quoted before using it as a lever.

evidence.claim: Material (nickel, alloys) is hedged at fixed prices until March 2027.
RFQ quote on 2026-09-19 at 6.31 versus a current price of 5.45 (valid from 2026-07-01 via index adjustment).
The supplier proposes a new price basis and AS-14404 surcharge clause for the coming period.
Framework runs to 2026-12-31 with 12-month auto-extension and 60 days' notice. Index formula has 0.45 material share, 0 % deadband and quarterly adjustment.
Historically settles about 3.1 pts below its ask and has accepted price decreases.
Financially solid (equity 33.9 %, credit index 177, unchanged); our share of its turnover is only 0.3 %.
Owner offered to open the calculation (hourly rates and material).
OTD of 88.0 % against a 95 % target; ppm 75; EUR 150 flat chargeback per complaint.

indicators.credit_index: 177 (12 months ago 177; higher is worse, >300 weak)
indicators.scorecard_trend: 2025Q4 green (otd 88.5, ppm 76) → 2026Q1 green (otd 92.0, ppm 43) → 2026Q2 green (otd 88.5, ppm 92) → 2026Q3 green (otd 88.0, ppm 75)
